howToUse: Use the anti blemish face wash twice a day, morning & evening. Pump out coin sized anti blemish face wash. Apply generously over wet face. Work into a rich lather and gently swirl it around your face to remove excess sebum and dirt. Wash your face and pat dry. Use it in the day or before going to bed every night. Wash your face with Man Matters' face wash and pat it dry with a clean napkin. Take 4-5 drops of the serum in your palm. Gently massage the product into your skin until it is completely absorbed. If you use it in the morning, top it off with a sunscreen.
